import json,collections
r=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]; out=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
a=[('ъььь','yes'),('ъъъъ','yes'),('ь','no'),('ьь','no'),('ь','yes'),('ъъъ','yes')]
for x,(s,p) in zip(r[len(out):],a):out.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],slots={str(i):c for i,c in enumerate(s,1)},confidence={str(i):'high' for i in range(1,len(s)+1)},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918=p,note=''))
out[75]['confidence']['1']='low'
out[75]['note']='Lower glyph portions are cut; visible stem top has no hard-sign flag.'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x in out:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(a)==len(r)
for x,y in zip(r,a):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,x['slots']+1)}
 assert set(y['slots'])==set(y['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in y['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in y['confidence'].values())
 assert y['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
counts=collections.Counter(v for y in a for v in y['slots'].values())
print('Verified count, order, and slot coverage:',len(a))
print('Slot calls:',dict(counts))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(y['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for y in a))
